title: AARYA Voice Lab Candidate Review Record (Phase 2 / VL-D3)
description: A human decision about the TECHNICAL fitness of a candidate segment -- quality, duration, segmentation, overlap. Distinct from schemas/identity_review.schema.json, which asks WHO is speaking; review_type is pinned to 'technical' so the two can never be confused, exactly mirroring how identity_review.schema.json pins 'identity'. Records are immutable; a correction supersedes rather than edits, so review history is never silently overwritten.

reason_code.description: Closed, technical-only vocabulary. There is deliberately no reason code here that could express a speaker judgement.

supersedes.description: review_id of the decision this one corrects, if any. Never null out and edit a prior record -- append a new one referencing it.
